scripts.check: biome check . && oxlint --type-aware && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check
scripts.format: biome format --write . && uv run ruff format
scripts.api:generate: uv run --package parfocal-api python -m parfocal_api.openapi && pnpm --filter @parfocal/api-client generate
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package parfocal-api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.test:db: docker compose up -d --wait && uv run pytest -m db
